scenes.purpose: Open with the user goal as a plain headline; headline and subtitle settle and hold for reading.
The goal arrives in the real MiniMax Code screen; highlight the message input where a task begins.
Show how the goal expands into multi-step work, illustrated by the real product screenshot; three homepage claims labelled as MiniMax's description.
Hold the exact CTA with readable URL and source attribution.

treatment.continuity: One white, ink and #2f8cff palette sampled from the screenshot runs throughout. The hook states the goal and names MiniMax Code's Coding and Work modes; it crossfades into the real interface focused on the message input where a goal is entered. The feature grid carries the real screenshot in each card so no card is empty, and is headed 'As MiniMax describes it' so every capability reads as a product claim. The endcard repeats the attribution beside the URL. Mallet pulse at 96 BPM with auto SFX on landing; no VO and no outcome sting.

treatment.message: A goal typed into the real MiniMax Code screen opens into the kinds of multi-step work MiniMax describes: Coding and Work modes, agents teaming up on tasks, and media, script and voiceover creation. All capability lines are attributed product claims, not measured results.
